connector.name: Hptsu MCP
connector.registryDescription: Search hpt.su - Russian/EAEU vehicle compliance documents: type approvals, certificates, VIN lookup.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.hpt.su over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package hptsu-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace su.hpt, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key issued at https://hpt.su/user/mcp/ (free tier available).

env.name: HPTSU_API_KEY
env.description: X-API-Key issued in the hpt.su cabinet (requires MCP_FREE or MCP_PAID scope).

env.name: HPTSU_BASE_URL
env.description: Override of the API base URL.
